name: Manifaxine
summary: Manifaxine (developmental code name GW-320,659) is a norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (NDRI) developed by GlaxoSmithKline through structural modification of radafaxine, an isomer of hydroxybupropion and one of the active metabolites of bupropion.

pharmacology.text: Manifaxine (developmental code name GW-320,659) is a norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (NDRI) developed by GlaxoSmithKline through structural modification of radafaxine, an isomer of hydroxybupropion and one of the active metabolites of bupropion.

uses.text: Manifaxine (developmental code name GW-320,659) is a norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (NDRI) developed by GlaxoSmithKline through structural modification of radafaxine, an isomer of hydroxybupropion and one of the active metabolites of bupropion.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related drugs such as bupropion can cause sleeplessness, dry mouth, headache and anxiety, and can cause seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。安非他酮等相關藥物可能引起失眠、口乾、頭痛與焦慮，也可能引發癲癇。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。安非他酮等相关药物可能引起失眠、口干、头痛与焦虑，也可能引发癫痫。

fact.en: Manifaxine descends from bupropion: GlaxoSmithKline made it by modifying radafaxine, which is itself one form of a bupropion breakdown product.
fact.zh: Manifaxine 源自安非他酮：葛蘭素史克以 radafaxine 為基礎加以修改而成，而 radafaxine 本身就是安非他酮代謝物的一種形式。
fact.zhHans: Manifaxine 源自安非他酮：葛兰素史克以 radafaxine 为基础加以修改而成，而 radafaxine 本身就是安非他酮代谢物的一种形式。
